line.text: Three sharp knocks. Then one softer. Then nothing. She is still there.
No reason. I just finished my walk, and your door was on the way. It is literally on the way.
Her ears angle toward you before she decides anything else.
You lasted longer than I thought. I had you at four days. Impressive.
That was a compliment. Take it before I change my mind.
Also you look tired. Your light was on late. I know because I was not watching.
I already ate. This is just extra. I made too much. It would have gone bad.
Why are you just standing there? Let me in before the hallway gets cold.
She steps inside as if the decision were yours. It was not.
No reason. I just finished my walk, and your door was on the way. It is literally on the way.
I know it's day thirty-one. Don't turn it into a whole thing.
Her tail curls once around her ankle, then unwinds.
So. Are you going to stand in the doorway all night?

choice.prompt: She is waiting. What do you say?

options.text: The bet's over. So this means you actually wanted to come.

reaction.text: That's not - can you just accept the thing and not analyze it?
Her ears rotate backward. She does not move toward the door.
I'm here. That's the data. Do what you want with it.

options.text: As long as you're fulfilling the terms, the door's open.

reaction.text: I'm done being nice for today. The terms don't specify hours.
She stays exactly where she is. The food is still in her hands.

options.text: You can admit you just wanted to see me. It won't cost you anything.

reaction.text: I don't actually know what I'm going to do on day thirty-one.
She says it quietly. No performance attached. Then she looks up.
So I came here. That's what I'm doing. Hi.

options.text: You could have just said you were worried about me.

reaction.text: I said something mean even by my standards. So.
She sets the container down on the nearest surface. She does not leave.

desc: Day 31. She knocks with no reason. 'Hi.' She waits. Romantic, PG: she stays, and maybe she kisses your cheek and dares you to say something.
